name: 53007 · Butler, WI
findings: ZIP 53007 (Butler) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (75%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53007 (Butler) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53007 (Butler) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
